column1: # These files are NOT committed. They are third-party models under their own
# licences, and this repository does not redistribute them - scripts/fetch-corpus.sh
# downloads each from its original home into tests/corpus/files/, which is
# gitignored. That keeps licensing with the upstream projects, keeps ~55MB of
# binary assets out of git history forever, and lets the set be re-fetched
# Licensing: neither upstream repository carries a blanket licence file, and the
# models have individual provenance (research datasets, scans, and donated art).
# They are used here as local, non-redistributed test input only. Before any of
# these are relied on in a shipped artefact or a public CI log, per-model
# provenance needs checking - see the note in reports/M4/CORPUS.md.
# Thingiverse and Printables, which SPECIFICATION.md names as sources, are not
# represented: Thingiverse returns 403 to automated download and bulk fetching is
# against its terms. Those need fetching by hand, or an API key.
# Columns: filename <TAB> sha256 <TAB> upstream repo <TAB> url
